narrative_purpose: Shows the bird's one-way lung: air sacs front and back driving a single-direction flow through the exchange tubes, the high-performance design Pandora's flyers echo.
subject: A flat schematic. In the centre, a set of parallel horizontal tubes (the lung's exchange tubes) with arrows all pointing the same direction, left to right. On the left end, a rounded balloon shape (a rear air sac); on the right end, another rounded balloon shape (a front air sac). A continuous looping arrow path shows air entering the rear balloon, passing one-way through the central tubes, and leaving via the front balloon. Small short arrows cross the central tubes at a slight angle, showing blood meeting the air stream crosswise.
scene: Empty dark space background, only the two balloon shapes, the central tube bundle, and the directional arrows.
camera: Flat head-on schematic view, no perspective, no 3D.
light: Flat even lighting; the tubes, balloons, and arrows glow on their own.
palette: Near-black background, cyan one-way flow arrows, teal balloon air sacs, faint magenta cross arrows for the blood.
style: Clean elegant infographic of thin glowing lines and arrows, like a vector schematic.
detail_level: Clear parallel tubes with same-direction arrows, two distinct balloon shapes at the ends, a few angled cross arrows; generous space.
composition: Rear balloon left, front balloon right, parallel exchange tubes spanning the middle, one continuous one-way arrow loop through it all.
